item.title: 9. Rank and the Matrix Spaces
item.description:
For a matrix $A$, the four fundamental subspaces (row space, column space, null space, left null space) and their dimensions are summarized by the rank and the rank–nullity theorem.

Four fundamental subspaces ($A \in \mathbb{R}^{m \times n}$)

Space Notation Subspace of Dimension
Row space $\text{Row}(A)$ $\mathbb{R}^n$ $\text{rank}(A)$
Column space $\text{Col}(A)$ $\mathbb{R}^m$ $\text{rank}(A)$
Null space $\text{Nul}(A)$ $\mathbb{R}^n$ $n - \text{rank}(A)$
Left null space $\text{Nul}(A^T)$ $\mathbb{R}^m$ $m - \text{rank}(A)$
  • $\text{Row}(A)$ = span of rows of $A$.
  • $\text{Col}(A)$ = span of columns of $A$ = range of $\mathbf{x} \mapsto A\mathbf{x}$.
  • $\text{Nul}(A) = {\mathbf{x} : A\mathbf{x} = \mathbf{0}}$.

Rank–nullity theorem: $\text{rank}(A) + \dim(\text{Nul}(A)) = n$.
